title: Second--order renewal asymptotics in the finite--variance regularly varying regime
summary: We develop a refined asymptotic theory for renewal processes with regularly varying inter-arrival distributions in the finite-variance regime. Assuming that $1-F(t)=t^{-α}L(t)$ with $α\in(2,3)$ and $L$ slowly varying, we establish second-order asymptotic expansions for both the renewal convolution and the renewal function. The results reveal a two-scale structure: the equilibrium tail $Q_F(t)$ governs the local renewal correction, while the integrated tail $ρ(t)=\int_t^\infty Q_F(u)\,du$ determines the global deviation from equilibrium.
